name: @shibainu16/bitbucket-dc-mcp
description: HTTP MCP server for Bitbucket Data Center REST API

scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun test test/e2e
scripts.test:all: bun run typecheck && bun test src && bun run build && bun test test/e2e
scripts.e2e:docker: docker compose -f test/e2e/compose.yaml up -d --build && E2E_STUB_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7990 bun test test/e2e; rc=$?; docker compose -f test/e2e/compose.yaml down; exit $rc
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test src && bun run build
scripts.inspect: bun run build && npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector node build/index.js
scripts.serve:stdio: bun run build && MCP_TRANSPORT=stdio node build/index.js
scripts.serve:http: bun run build && MCP_TRANSPORT=http PORT=3000 node build/index.js

author: lvluu
